player_prompt.intro:
I ka jwe Mastermind.
I ka kan ka kɛ {code_length} chiffre de long, kɔnɔ chiffre kɔnɔ 1 fo {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
N'a fɔ jwe, i ka se ka jwe ka formatɛ: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ jwe, i ka na feedbackɛ kɔnɔ formɛ de pegs noirs et blancs.
Peg noirɛ ka kɔnɔ chiffre sahi kɔnɔ position sahi, pendant peg blancɛ ka kɔnɔ chiffre sahi kɔnɔ position fausse.
I ka {max_turns} tours ka deviner le code.
player_prompt.with_repeats: ni seginli bɛ se ka kɛ a la
player_prompt.no_duplicates: ni fɛn wɛrɛ tɛ a la.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I ma jaabi ni jatidenw ye minnu farala ɲɔgɔn kan ka kɛ yɔrɔ fila daɲɛw ye, u datugulen don bolokanba kɔrɔ.
invalid_move.not_integers: O bɛɛ ka kan ka kɛ jatiden dafalenw ye.
invalid_move.wrong_length: O jateminɛ ka kan ka {code_length} nimerow de sɔrɔ.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Jatidenw bɛɛ ka kan ka kɛ 1 ni {num_numbers} cɛ.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Jatiden fila tɛ se ka kɛ.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Aw ye {guess} dɔn ka ban. I bɛ se k'a wɛrɛ ta wa?

game_action.feedback: N'a fɔ [{guess}]. Ka bɔ: {black_pegs} bɔɛrɛ jɛ, {white_pegs} bɔɛrɛ wulɛn.

outcome.win: I y'a daŋɛ koodi la, {black_pegs} kɔrɔlen {code_length} la ka ɲɛfɔlɔn ka waleya
outcome.turn_limit: A y'a jira ko a bɛ se ka yɛlɛma. I ye jatiden {percent} kɛmɛsarada dɔn k'u bɛnnen to.
